summary: Silo Pharma filed an 8-K reporting a November 5, 2026 private placement with accredited investors: 136,005 common shares at $1.50 and pre-funded warrants for up to 430,661 shares at $1.4999 (nominal $0.0001 exercise, immediate, 4.99% blocker adjustable to 9.99% on 61 days' notice). Net proceeds are about $815,000 after placement agent fees and expenses; the deal closed November 6, 2026. A registration rights agreement requires a resale registration statement within 30 days and effectiveness within 60 days (90 days on full SEC review). This is an ordinary financing, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and resale-registration timing.
